Definition: Gereshom, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gershom = "foreigner"; 1) firstborn son of Moses and Zipporah; 2) firstborn son of Levi; 3) a son of the priestly family of Phinehas who returned from exile with Ezra
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
